reconfigure.title: {model}
reconfigure.description: How this model should speak a reply that is still being written.

data_description.stream_mode:
Automatic lets the app decide for each reply, from the real-time factor it has measured for this model and voice on its own host: spoken as it is written when the model keeps ahead of its audio, held until the whole reply is rendered when it does not, and held while the model is still unmeasured. It never runs dry.

The other two take the decision away. Stream insists on speaking the reply as it is written, whatever the app measured — on a host that cannot keep ahead of its audio, playback stalls between sentences, audibly. Wait for the whole reply insists on rendering everything before anything plays: it never stalls, and the wait before the first word is the longest of the three.

abort.model_comes_from_the_server: Models are not added here. Download one in the Cortex TTS app and it appears on this page by itself.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. It applies to the next reply.

options.auto: Automatic — let the app decide for each reply, never runs dry
options.streaming: Stream — speak as it is written, stalls on a host that cannot keep up
options.buffered: Wait for the whole reply — never stalls, longest wait
